reason: The wait is already a long poll: GET /v1/deploy/canary/<id>?wait_s=20, which canary.read holds on the LISTEN of tower_work until the job's end or its limit (WAIT_MAX_S, under the API's 30 s), asked again until the verdict or deploy.canary_limit_s + 60.
